ball-tracker.usage: Target ball tracking trainer: memorize the gold-marked ball first; once the mark disappears all balls look the same, so keep tracking it in the moving crowd. Count-change mode keeps mixing in new balls to test sustained attention; whole-scene rotation tests spatial orientation. Tracking accuracy, errors and trends are recorded automatically for a training report.

lottery.usage: Event lottery wheel: import a name list, set prize counts and roll. Wheel motion is precisely planned and stop points are fair and random — perfect for annual parties, events and classroom roll calls.

meme-generator.usage: Meme generator: upload a local image, add top and bottom text with adjustable font and color, preview and download. Images are processed entirely in your browser.

nickname-text.usage: Fancy nickname generator with 20+ Unicode styles: zalgo, cursive, bold, italic, outline, fraktur, circled, squared, superscript, subscript, mirrored and more. Great for game nicknames, couple usernames and bios — generated locally in your browser.

random-number.usage: Random number generator with custom min, max and count, plus unique draws. Quick for draws, grouping, games and test data — generated locally in your browser.

palette-generator.usage: Color palette generator based on color theory: harmonious schemes, multiple variations, one-click color copy and export. A quick reference for design, slides and UI color selection.

browser-info.usage: Browser information detector showing browser version, OS, screen resolution and device info for compatibility checks, data reporting and frontend debugging.

image-filter.usage: Image filter tool: apply grayscale, blur, vintage, hue rotation and other effects with adjustable strength and live preview, then download. Images are processed locally in your browser.

morse.usage: Morse code encoder/decoder supporting Chinese, English and numbers, with real-time translation and a Morse code table. Learn Morse, share secret messages or demo communication principles.
